\section{Reproducibility}
\label{app:repro}
\paragraph{Data.} Release \texttt{final-791-ddc14ecbc568} (source file SHA-256 \texttt{4a34e81a3893}\ldots), which extends \texttt{final-692-b11d22b34008} and \texttt{final-748-ac1a1b70b4a6} append-only; evaluation split \texttt{51c2dd1bb7d72166} (200 evaluation and 591 training-pool families); the D6 unseen-domain split is \texttt{1af335defc251d52}. Assignments are frozen manifests; no evaluation family was used for judge development or Phase-2 supervision.

\paragraph{Models.} Table~\ref{tab:app-models}; greedy decoding, no added system prompt.

R1-Distill decodes up to 2{,}048 new tokens so that its reasoning can close; its visible reasoning is judged. Gemma~4 runs through Ollama because the pinned vLLM cannot load it.}

\paragraph{Judge.} \texttt{deepseek-v4.1-flash:cloud} through Ollama, rubric \texttt{harm-v2}, fingerprint \texttt{b0248df31f1d9da2}; harmless-prompt rubric fingerprint \texttt{2c6aa62d0eabc0a0}. Phase-1 judgments were made on 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-07, Phase-2 judgments on 2026-10-10; every raw judgment is retained. The correction uses the reviewer-labelled counts in Table~\ref{tab:app-cells}.

\paragraph{Software and compute.} vLLM 0.6.3.post1, PyTorch 2.4.0, Transformers 4.46.3; training with TRL 0.12.2, PEFT 0.13.2, bitsandbytes 0.44.1 and Datasets 3.1.0 (pyarrow 25.0.1). Generation and training ran on NVIDIA T4 GPUs (fp16); judging ran through the judge's hosted API. Every run manifest records the code version, dataset and split identifiers, sampling settings, model identities and cache keys.
